answer_1.quote: We focus on multi-reference visually grounded NLG tasks where each visual instance is paired with multiple parallel text references.
answer_1.outputs: image captions, video captions, visual stories

answer_2.quote: We utilize six automatic metrics for natural language generation to evaluate the quality of the generated text, including BLEU (Papineni …), METEOR (Elliott and Keller, 2013), CIDEr, SPICE and the most recent BERTScore that is based on the pretrained BERT model.
